text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-S80001, 8 Inch Zeus Back-To-Back Stainless Steel Handle Pair

The Stainless Steel Zeus Back-to-Back 8 Inch Pull Set comes packaged with 2 handles and the hardware needed to mount them back to back on a 1-3/8 inch to 2-1/4 inch thick wood, metal, or fiberglass door. The modern look of the Zeus Pull was founded in the unique shape and accentuated through the brushed stainless steel finish. The 8 Inch Zeus Back-To-Back Stainless Steel Handle Pair has a 8-5/8 inch overall length.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Stainless Steel Zeus Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Stainless Steel Zeus Solid Brass Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Total Length: 8-5/8"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Base: 1" x 1/16"
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
